title: The Great 202 Jailbreak - Computerphile
summary: Computerphile with Professor Brailsford on how a 1979 Bell Labs team reverse engineered a Linotron 202 phototypesetter over a summer to get high-quality print output. It covers typesetting history and the later 2013 rebuild of the famous vacation memo.
why: Recommended alongside the original paper and Unix history threads as an engaging account of the typesetter hack.

quote.text: explained the brilliant and exiting history of this paper and its recreation, as well as the history of Phototypesetters.
